remoteMcp.connectionFailed.en: Could not connect. Please try again.

remoteMcp.headersIncomplete.en: Enter both a name and value for each header.
remoteMcp.headersIncomplete.zh-CN: 请为每个请求头同时填写名称和值。

remoteMcp.invalidManagementUrl.en: Use an HTTPS console URL without credentials.
remoteMcp.invalidManagementUrl.zh-CN: 请使用不含凭据的 HTTPS 控制台 URL。

remoteMcp.loadingSavedAccess.zh-CN: 正在加载已保存的访问权限…

remoteMcp.savedAccessFailed.en: Could not load saved access. Retry before changing this connection.
remoteMcp.savedAccessFailed.zh-CN: 无法加载已保存的访问权限。请重试后再更改此连接。

remoteMcp.savedCredentials.en: Saved credentials are retained when these fields are left blank. Enter a replacement only to change them.
remoteMcp.savedCredentials.zh-CN: 这些字段留空时会保留已保存的凭据。仅在需要更改时输入替换值。

remoteMcp.signInUnavailable.en: Paperclip couldn’t open sign-in. Use the sign-in link below to continue.
remoteMcp.signInUnavailable.zh-CN: Paperclip 无法打开登录窗口。请使用下方登录链接继续。
